Subsequently, a stepwise multiple linear regression model was made to examine potential correlations between miRNA expression and patient characteristics. The following parameters were incorporated: gender, age, smoking (pack years), number of days between trauma and primary surgery, fracture occurred during multi-trauma event, diabetes mellitus, osteoporosis, hypertension, and arthritic diseases.
